analyst_view.overall: Early view: Marseille host Nice in a rivalry fixture between two sides in the top six, with Celta Vigo to come in the Europa League four days later. Marseille went into the break on five straight league wins under Bruno Genesio and Nice had won four of five under Olivier Pantaloni, though Nice's injuries (Antoine Mendy, Laurent Abergel, Moise Bombito) need checking.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals. I stay close to it: Marseille score 2.2 a game, the league's best, and Nice 1.5, while both concede between 1.2 and 1.4. Amine Gouiri's form is the main reason not to go lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners. I lean slightly higher: Nice win 5.7 corners a game (4th) and Marseille 4.5, and both like to keep the ball. Ten looks a fair middle.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards. I lean slightly lower: despite the rivalry, these are two of the cleaner teams in the league (Marseille 11.2 fouls a game, Nice 9.9). The referee and the occasion could change that, so this is a mild lean.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.4 shots. I lean lower: Marseille average 13.2 shots and Nice 12.1, which sums to about 25. With Celta four days later, Marseille may also take a more controlled approach once ahead.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 shots on target. I lean lower: Marseille average 4.7 on target and Nice 4.0. Nine is a more natural figure for two possession sides.
